systems.system: plateforme de délivrance des certificats de perte (www.certificatdeperte.bj)
systems.country_label: plateforme du Centre de documentation et de sécurité publique (CDSP)
systems.tiers: sole channel for loss certificates from 1 October 2026 under a note de service of the Director General; electronic payment only; stations no longer issue the certificate, and station heads are to inform people declaring a loss and help them use the platform

note: A public portal for one document, the loss certificate (lost documents are single-function in the typology): the declarant, not the station, enters the request, so no fact for station records.
